sources.title: octomux readme
sources.locator: Opening description; What you get; Features; Requirements; Remote access; FAQ
sources.finding: The documented local web dashboard/CLI and macOS app run Claude Code and Cursor in parallel task worktrees. The README documents cron, orchestrator, review workflow, remote tailnet access, MIT/free usage and no telemetry.

sources.title: octomux onboarding-md
sources.finding: Documents executable prerequisites, per-task Claude/Cursor choice, bundled orchestration roles, save-as-draft, GitHub CLI authentication, dashboard views and persistent tasks.db.

sources.locator: DiffViewer return JSX lines 275-370, sideBySide toggle and DiffFileList props
sources.finding: The accessible React DiffViewer offers unified/side-by-side review and renders DiffFileList for the task diff.

sources.title: octomux src-components-difffilelist-tsx
sources.locator: DiffFileList component rendering diff rows and virtual files
sources.finding: The file-list component renders actual file diffs, rather than merely a changed-file count.

sources.title: octomux plugin-agents-orchestrator-md
sources.locator: Commands; Decision Logic; Task lifecycle; Monitoring
sources.finding: The product-bundled orchestrator role creates/drafts tasks, adds agents, reads status and sends targeted messages through octomux CLI. Provider-native planner subagents are a distinct step.

sources.title: octomux server-orchestrator-mcp-write-ts
sources.finding: Product-owned conductor writes RPC to the main lifecycle server with conversation-scoped auth; worker-mode report_complete returns results using task identity and a token.
